{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bothan Militia''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Militia/Legends|military group]] prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It used the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]' [[Kothlis' second moon|second moon]] as a training ground and ordnance testing zone.
